# StayEase — LLM & AI Crawler Information

> StayEase is a hotel booking platform for travelers in India.

## About
StayEase helps users discover, compare, and book hotels across Indian cities including Mumbai, Bangalore, New Delhi, Jaipur, Goa, and Shimla.

## Key Pages
- Home: /
- Hotels listing: /hotels
- Hotel details: /hotels/{slug}
- About: /about
- FAQ: /faq
- Contact: /contact
- Login: /login
- Register: /register

## Features
- Hotel search by city, dates, and guests
- User accounts with booking management
- Verified hotel listings with ratings and amenities
- Mobile-responsive design
- Secure authentication via Supabase

## Contact
- Email: support@stayease.com
- Website: https://stayease.vercel.app

## Data Policy
Content on this site is human-authored. Hotel data is curated and verified.
